implementation.scope: chat -> list -> same chat in one browser session
implementation.access: POST /join remains mandatory before any RAM reuse
implementation.store: existing FPMessageStore172 only; no new persistent storage
eligibility: room was successfully rendered earlier in this session
server join selects the current authoritative window
every server-selected message has a safe canonical MessageStore record
same encrypted content metadata, or canonical edit/delete state is at least as new
implementation.fallback: If any server-selected message is unavailable or unsafe in RAM, the whole window uses the existing decrypt/render path.
implementation.updates: Existing WebSocket/message-actions/lifecycle synchronization updates canonical MessageStore state.
implementation.unreadAndPosition: join unread/viewState/cursors remain authoritative; FPScroll173 restores position

benchmark.environment: isolated Linux headless Chromium + local SQLite; no network throttling
benchmark.qualification: Both first and repeat opens still execute the normal join access check. This benchmark isolates same-session RAM/decrypt/render reuse on local transport; it is not a production/mobile forecast.

historicalFailedRun.reason: Regression incorrectly required decrypt fallback after delete. Existing sync had already cached the newly exposed neighbor message, so the post-delete window remained fully and safely reusable. Product behavior was correct; the test was corrected.

limits: Five benchmark pairs only, so no p95.
Headless Chromium/local SQLite, no network throttling.
RAM reuse lasts only for the current page session and disappears on reload.
Media reuse requires exact media metadata equality; otherwise the whole window falls back.
